name: Pike Push-Up
steps: Place your hands shoulder-width apart and lift your hips into an inverted V, bending your knees slightly if needed.
Shift your weight forward onto your hands while keeping your hips stacked high.
Bend your elbows slightly backward and out to lower the top of your head smoothly toward a spot just ahead of your hands.
Press forcefully through your palms to straighten your arms and push back into the high pike starting position.
tips: Aim your head forward of your fingertips in a tripod pattern rather than straight down between your hands.
Keep your core braced and avoid letting your elbows flare completely straight out to the sides.
